Market today: The mood is cautious with rising Treasury yields, which is a real drag on your tech and chip names. Higher rates make future earnings less valuable and increase borrowing costs, hitting growth stocks hard.

Your holdings: SOXL is a big concern, down -26.91% and flagged "SELL." SPAL is also leveraged, down -12.64%, and on "WATCH." Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep a close eye on Treasury yields. Continued increases will put more pressure on your highly concentrated tech/chip book.

Bottom line: Focus on managing risk in your leveraged, underperforming positions given the rate environment.
plays: Trim SOXL: It's a leveraged "SELL" at -26.91%. Consider reducing exposure to manage risk, especially with rising yields.
Watch SPAL: This leveraged ETF is on "WATCH" and down -12.64%. Respect its stop at 21.38 to limit further losses.
No new buys today - hold and watch: While some scanner setups look good, the overall market mood with rising yields suggests caution for new tech/chip entries.
